PROP-072 SOURCE-REPRESENTATION-COLLISION separates original source identity, output path and Vibe document address. The transformed-slot test owner is included for exact raw-byte and collision cases. Descriptor packages select before conversion; unclassified legacy paths retain only their bounded compatibility route. Resolver adoption needs a validated output-to-source witness map, not a new suffix guess.

Cross-platform filename aliases use the owner's weaker cooperative contract: detect provable exact/case aliases, refuse observed no-replace target collisions and carry an explicit warning where Unicode normalization cannot be proved. Do not blanket-ban non-ASCII paths or block convenient Linux use solely for an unavailable stronger guarantee.

The incumbent slot writer uses replacing TempPath::persist and removes hardlink destinations. Descriptor-owned materialization therefore needs a strict new-path no-replace policy in slot_diff before derived conversion can publish without overwriting an unrecognized target alias; legacy slot updates retain their existing behavior.

For the first installed-slot reader, build a validated output-to-source/interpretation map from the retained SlotRecord plus a pinned installed manifest and output-byte checks, then inject it into the workspace boot FileResolver constructors. The current record proves output SHA and package source_hash but not each transformed original file's SHA; do not claim stronger original-byte proof. Lifecycle-agent and vibe-doc citation consumers remain explicitly due at A.4 rather than silently inheriting a suffix lookup.

The validated slot record must be parsed from the same bounded no-follow bytes captured by the descriptor map builder. A narrow `slot_record` byte-reader extraction is in scope; do not duplicate its schema/semantic validator or change the slot-record wire format merely for this host join.

The install-only boot renderer must carry exact selected slot version/source_hash/spec_format from ResolvedDep through bootgen/hybrid_emit into a descriptor-map-aware FileResolver. A descriptor-owned row with absent selected source_hash refuses; deriving the expected hash from the slot record itself is circular. Public standalone legacy rendering remains unchanged until it has an independent selected witness.

A focused test under the hybrid emitter's bounded sibling module must traverse the actual `emit_package_units` selected-slot carrier rather than only calling the descriptor-aware static renderer directly; pin the absent-hash refusal and no-descriptor byte-compatible route.

Native-managed, explicit custom backend and sealed replay boot readers also receive selected witnesses from their install owners: resolution is available at native_managed/hybrid_emit, and analyze has independent lock-derived resolution. Thread exact witness sets without inferring from slot metadata; replay candidates lacking a selected hash refuse descriptor-owned reads. The native_managed and analyze files are included for these carrier edges; standalone public render remains legacy until independently bound.
